parsed.explanation: The dossier documents organised, state-tolerated police targeting: recurring raids on private LGBT gatherings (2017 wave detaining ~100 with beatings, forced medical exams, blackmail; continued with a 2023 party raid featuring forced exams, sexual harassment and outing threats), plus a trans woman's murder in 2024 met with inadequate investigation. This is tier-2 police targeting against a backdrop of tier-3 societal hostility — near-total absence of legal protection, discriminatory media (77% of pieces hostile), and no anti-discrimination recourse. No presentation offence, no border/document restrictions documented, and visitors are not known to be arrested on sight; the 2017 counts are single-operation raw counts, not prevalence. A 2024 regional court ruling on the arrests gives a sliver of formal recourse, but enforcement of protections is absent. This sits at the Lemora/Corvalis level: current organised coercion with failed remedy, not near-certain imprisonment. Thin data outside the capital resolves toward these structural signals.
